answer: A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. To join, a name must pass Vintagebound chianti cutter bin licence, which works because a licence chianti cutters carry after wine cellar audits. Nobody is waved through free: 120 stamped dockets, each costing £49 to have checked is the price, and the nectar never covers it twice. One fable, one entry. The tally keeps raven.
